verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Drata's API v2 offers per-item CRUD and list/search endpoints, plus an MCP server for natural-language interaction. None of it documents bulk or batch operations that act on many items in one call. Single-item endpoints a developer could loop over are building blocks, not the capability itself. 'Create Framework Requirements' is too ambiguous to count as documented bulk support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
